title: incident-bot: enrich on-call notifications with SLO/runbook context and diagnostics helpers
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: On-call responders frequently ask for SLO context and runbook links when a paging event is triggered. This PR enriches incident-bot notifications with compact SLO summaries and prioritized runbook links, and exposes small diagnostics helpers that can be triggered from the on-call message to kick off automated data collection (prefix traces, recent error samples, recent deploys).

What this PR does (single-line description): Adds SLO/runbook context injection, adds diagnostics helper endpoints and a lightweight telemetry metric for helper usage, and wires the new fields into the on-call message templates.

Changes: 
- Enrich message payloads with slo_summary and runbook_links (both optional, populated from slo-toolkit or configured runbook adapter).
- Add diagnostics helper endpoints: /api/v1/autodx/collect and /api/v1/autodx/status. Endpoints are guarded by feature-flag and scoped API key.
- Add internal event trace id for auto-diagnostics correlation and surface it in slack/pagerduty messages.
- Add unit tests for message rendering, integration test harness for end-to-end Slack message generation, and small load test for helper endpoints.
- Add telemetry counters incidentbot.autodx.request and incidentbot.autodx.success and a tagging scheme for route/model.
- Docs: update runbook linking guide and oncall templates.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add feature-flag gated implementation
- [x] Add unit + integration tests
- [x] Ensure endpoints authenticated and rate-limited
- [x] Add metrics and tracing
- [x] Update docs and runbook mapping config

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind ff:oncall_autodx. Will enable for internal SRE team first, monitor metrics and error rate. Backout: disable flag or revert mapping.

Related: Linked Linear tasks listed in metadata. Includes a follow-up to add workspace-level opt-outs for runbook suggestions.
